title: StructuredIntent
description: Typed intent payload produced by intelligence providers to propose storage cleanup operations without direct execution authority.

target_reclaim_bytes.description: Optional desired storage target to reclaim in physical bytes

max_risk.description: Upper bound of risk permitted for proposed cleanup items

preferred_categories.description: Preferred categories to target (e.g. BUILD_ARTIFACT, PACKAGE_MANAGER_CACHE)

excluded_candidate_ids.description: Specific candidate IDs the user asked to retain

include_developer_artifacts.description: Whether to evaluate developer caches and build artifacts

prefer_reversible_actions.description: Whether trashable operations should be strictly preferred over permanent deletion

explanation_requested.description: Whether the user requested a plain-language summary of findings
